## 2026-11-20 continuation — silent_exit root-caused and fixed; battery re-run 10/10 with receipts + native evidence

- **Root cause (verbatim):** the deadline wrapper's bare `setsid`
  under `podman exec`. On the podman VM the exec'd process is already
  a process-group leader, so util-linux `setsid` forks and its parent
  exits `0` immediately; podman treats the exec as complete and tears
  down the session, killing the still-running Pi/Claude child tree
  before any output is emitted — `agent_end_cause exited{0}`, 0
  receipts, 0 native-log bytes on every leg. It is NOT provisioning,
  env, stdin, CWD, or argv: the rendered command run without the
  wrapper streams `agent_start … agent_end` events (Pi ~7 KB);
  `timeout` alone works; bare `setsid` alone reproduces the zero-byte
  exit; `setsid --wait` restores full output and propagates `0` /
  nonzero / `124` statuses (verified manually in the image).
- **Fix:** `hharness_helper::podman::wrap_kill` emits
  `setsid --wait timeout --kill-after=<grace> <duration> …`
  (`crates/hh-helper/src/podman.rs`); doc updates in
  `crates/hh-runner/src/cell.rs`, `crates/hh-helper/src/server.rs`,
  `crates/hh-helper/src/protocol.rs`. Golden/stub regressions updated:
  `crates/hh-helper/tests/r6_39.rs`, `crates/hh-runner/tests/r6_45j.rs`,
  `crates/hh-runner/tests/exec_drain.rs`.
- **Second defect found on re-run:** the scratch replay lane declared
  `"model": "replay"` → receipts attributed under a non-priced model
  key (`replay@ollama`) no evidence table can index. Corrected to
  `"model": "glm-5.3-flash"` (the recorded/priced model); the driver
  docstring now states the requirement (`w4x-smoke-driver.py`).
- **Fold correction (AG6 basis):** `proxy_stats` in
  `w4x-smoke-driver.py` previously counted only
  `measurement.cost.attributed` rows — which §4.9 replay mints none of
  by contract (`budget_id "replay:none"`, no slice, no settlement), so
  AG6 could never pass in replay. The fold now counts durable
  `hh.model_proxy.receipt/1` docs (terminal `model.call.completed`/
  `failed` `response_ref` → doc `proxy.slot_id == sid`) as
  `receipt_count` — the mode-universal AG6 basis — and reports
  `cost_attributed_count` separately. Endpoint errors are read off the
  terminal event `disposition` member directly.
- **Re-run (run-id `w4x-pp0-r5`, `docs/build/reports/2026-11-20-r6.55-w4x-pp0/`):**
  10/10 legs executed; every leg `receipt_count ≥ 1` AND
  `native_log_bytes > 0`; 9/10 all-gates-pass, 1 held.
